name: Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the European citizens’ initiative entitled ‘My Voice, My Choice: For Safe and Accessible Abortion’
part_text:
This resolution does not change any law. It sets out the opinion of a political group in the European Parliament on a citizens' petition called "My Voice, My Choice", which asks for EU funding for abortion services. The group says abortion policy is a matter for each member state alone, that the EU has no power to set it up, and that the European Commission was wrong to accept the petition for registration. It asks for a full impact assessment before any future proposal.

- Nothing changes in law; this is only a stated opinion.
- It concerns member states, the Commission, and petition organisers.
- Next, Parliament votes on the resolution; it is then sent to the Council and Commission.
